evidence.claim: Card transaction history for C11891-K1 shows multiple online purchases over several months. Transaction 3478782 on 2016-11-22 for $292.36 (risk score 0.79) represents a significantly higher amount than the card's typical online spending pattern, which consists predominantly of smaller amounts ($20-$55). There is no distinct card testing sequence immediately prior to this transaction, but the transaction stands out as an unusual, high-value online burst/outlier purchase.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Customer states they did not make these purchases and still has the card.

initial.reason: Moderate-high risk score (0.79) for an unusually large online transaction compared to historical spending patterns, warranting step-up authentication.

final.reason: Customer confirmed they did not make the purchase and are still in possession of the card, confirming unauthorized card-not-present fraud under $2,500 exposure.
